scope: Same ten complete diverse frames; four separately trained/fixed-format students. Fresh AEE and actual source statistics, not a same-function speedup or full-network integerization.

definition.theta_weighted_terms: sum_k active_columns[k] * nnz(actual compiled W[:,k]); first assignments and 3x3 halo repeats included. Source theta is folded into static coefficients where compiled; no multibit activation assumption.
definition.h8_logical_vectors: sum_k nrv_rows_by_k[k] * count_H8(any_h_in_H8 W[h,k]!=0). NRV combines T10 and two adjacent required output positions at one k. Logical demands, not physical SRAM or bus transactions.
definition.continuous_products: Actual compiled nonzero coefficient count times required output instances. No captured continuous-value-zero histogram is available; no unmeasured dynamic MAC skipping. General 24x16 products are separate from theta*g AACs and from preview Q5 shift terms.
definition.numerical_scope: Signed24 f14 completed coordinates, RNE/saturation at every completion/merge; signed16 per-matrix coefficients and signed48 accumulation. Each source/consumer retains its own theta; signed thresholds and constant-row logic read directly from exported constants.
definition.fixed_boundaries: Only even/even Conv2 outputs are required. Their 3x3 halo still needs full-spatial sn2/preview Conv1. Original floating Conv2/BN/add shadows run in the GPU reference but are excluded from required workload.
definition.uncharged: No source encoding/queue/physical bank/port scheduling, CMVM/CSD graph, gate comparison, RNE/merge/control energy, peak-live allocation or full downstream-network cost; no cycles or speed prediction.

evidence.projection_provenance: The unchanged actual PED spike-conv weight from TemporalConsumerCapture; the four recovery parameter sets replace Conv2/PED continuous factors and neurons, not this spike-conv weight.

common_preview_not_in_fixed_product_tota.scope: Common frozen R32 preview second factor and full sn2 definition. V is power-of-two Q5 and A has34 nonzeros; no arbitrary equivalence of their costs to 24x16 MAC. Both students get any separately validated A/V exchange or fused/CMVM implementation; this ledger preserves evaluated rounding boundaries.

TF32.note: Inherited for surrounding FP network; integer dot accumulations are exact-domain FP64 emulation.

static_products_per_frame.scope: Required lattice, exact coefficient zeros; completed24 times weight16 into48. Continuous input-zero skipping is not measurable from these range files. Operation counts are not cycles.

observed_numeric.scope: Full-frame software writes/ranges, including software full-spatial Z24. Required Conv2 computation is anchor-only; these element counts are not physical traffic or peak storage. Observed bits/saturation do not justify narrowing the fixed24/48 domain or extrapolating to825.

shared_minus_raw_diagonal.gate: Use the stage-specific cost vector, plus actual traffic/state/control. The reported MAC/AAC ratio threshold assumes a single AAC cost across U8, U16 and FP32-weight stages and a single continuous-product cost; it is a simplified diagnostic, not a device-cost assumption or a general hardware necessary bound.
shared_minus_raw_diagonal.nonconclusion: Logical vector count reduction can motivate finite-bandwidth/energy work, but is not an SRAM-read count or an extra-port entitlement. Earlier FP64 4/16 bound scan is a different function and cannot be assigned to these fixed-format students.

followup_B.strong_control: This raw-diagonal fixed student, with the same original-coordinate continuous branch, U8 preview, U16 anchor Conv2, compiled threshold directions, actual sources, and all legal sparse/CMVM/fusion permissions.
followup_B.retained_question: Can a same-format, same-resource fusion reduce shared AsZ/inverse/continuous-readout cost or demonstrate a measured physical traffic advantage that repays its extra work while meeting the raw control accuracy tradeoff?
followup_B.required_numeric_boundary: Each existing RNE24 completion is part of the evaluated function. Moving A through F/V, replacing inverse with UI+UFZ, or folding UF changes rounding locations; it needs its own functional/AEE check. Zero observed saturation alone does not permit reassociation.
followup_B.not_a_claim: No new mechanism or hardware advantage is established; ordinary shared-family and raw-family parameter recovery remain viable. No extra rank/width/port/GPU sweep was performed.
